name: Digital Publishing

prompts.header: Write the headline last. Would it make someone stop scrolling, without overselling the story? The standfirst should promise what the piece delivers.
prompts.text: Write for the screen: lead with what's new, keep paragraphs short, and link each claim to its source in the sentence that makes it, using [text](https://…).
prompts.quote: Choose a line that only this person could have said. Is it accurate, and fair to what they meant in context?
prompts.embed: Link to the original source, not a page about it. Would your editor trust it? Keep a screenshot in case it changes.
prompts.references: In this pack you source claims with links in the text. Use this list only for sources you can't link to, such as interviews or print.

reflection: Who is this story for, and how did that shape what you included and left out?
Which source was hardest to verify, and how did you check it?
What would you change if you had another week?
